name: Appzo Chatbot Widget
author: Appzo

sections.description:
Transform your website’s customer engagement with Appzo’s intelligent chatbot widget.

The Appzo Chatbot Widget plugin allows you to easily integrate a powerful AI-driven chatbot into your WordPress website. Enhance your customer support, capture leads, and provide 24/7 assistance to your website visitors.

Key Features

  • Easy Integration – Simple setup with just your widget ID
  • Customizable Positioning – Choose from multiple positioning options (bottom-right, center-right, bottom-left)
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on your website’s performance
  • Accessible – Built with accessibility best practices
  • Secure – All data transmission is encrypted and secure

How It Works

  1. Sign up for an Appzo account at appzo.ai
  2. Create your chatbot and get your widget ID
  3. Install this plugin and enter your widget ID in the settings
  4. Choose your preferred position and enable the widget
  5. Your intelligent chatbot is now live on your website!

Perfect For

  • E-commerce websites – Help customers find products and answer questions
  • Service businesses – Provide instant support and capture leads
  • Content websites – Guide visitors to relevant content
  • Any website – Improve user engagement and satisfaction

Premium Features

Upgrade your Appzo account to unlock advanced features:
* Advanced AI training and customization
* Integration with popular CRM systems
* Detailed analytics and reporting
* Custom branding options
* Priority support

Support

For technical support and questions:
* Visit our documentation: https://appzo.ai/docs
* Contact support: https://appzo.ai/support
* Email: support@appzo.ai

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to Appzo’s external service to provide chatbot functionality. Please review:
* Appzo Privacy Policy: https://appzo.ai/privacy
* Appzo Terms of Service: https://appzo.ai/terms

Data sent to Appzo includes:
* Chat conversations between users and the chatbot
* Basic website information (URL, referrer)
* Anonymous usage statistics

No personal data is collected without explicit user consent during chat interactions.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Appzo Chatbot Widget”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Setup

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Appzo Chatbot
  2. Enter your Widget ID (get this from your Appzo dashboard)
  3. Choose your preferred widget position
  4. Enable the widget
  5. Save your settings
sections.faq:
How do I get a Widget ID?

  1. Sign up for a free account at appzo.ai
  2. Create your chatbot
  3. Navigate to the Integration section
  4. Copy your Widget ID from the WordPress integration instructions

Is the plugin free?

Yes, this plugin is completely free. However, you’ll need an Appzo account to use the chatbot service. Appzo offers both free and premium plans.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and loads asynchronously, so it won’t affect your website’s loading speed.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

The basic styling is handled by the plugin, but you can customize your chatbot’s behavior, responses, and branding through your Appzo dashboard.

Is the chatbot mobile-friendly?

Yes, the widget is fully responsive and works seamlessly on all devices, including smartphones and tablets.

Can I disable the widget on specific pages?

Currently, the widget appears on all pages when enabled. Page-specific controls will be added in future updates.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data transmission between your website and Appzo’s servers is encrypted using industry-standard security protocols.
